title: Research Methods in Biological Psychology
summary: Stereotaxic lesioning; types of lesions; staining techniques; imaging techniques (EEG, MEG, X-ray, MRI, fMRI); advantages of fMRI over PET.
revision: Imaging: EEG=electrical, MEG=magnetic fields, MRI=structure, fMRI=blood oxygenation/activity, PET=metabolism. fMRI advantages: no radiation, better resolution, repeatable.
confusions: Confusing MRI with fMRI (structure vs activity).

notes.t: A technique to destroy a specific brain area using precise coordinates from a brain atlas, to study the function of that area.
fMRI advantages over PET: no radioactive tracer, better spatial resolution, non-invasive, can be repeated safely.
UGC NET frequently asks to match imaging techniques with what they measure and the advantages of fMRI over PET.

mnemonics.text: E — EEG (electrical), M — MEG (magnetic fields), M — MRI (structure), F — fMRI (activity/blood), P — PET (metabolism)
